source_dir.description: The directory containing the source files to be protected by parchive.

parity_dir.description: The directory where the generated .par parity volumes will be stored.

num_parity_volumes.description: Number of parity volumes to create. Allows recovery of 'X' missing source volumes given 'X' parity volumes.

verbosity.description: Verbosity level for parchive output. Corresponds to the -v flag.

action.description: The parchive operation to perform: 'check' (verify), 'recover' (restore), or 'add' (create parity).

file_extensions.description: List of file extensions to include in the parity calculation. If empty, all files are included.

files_per_par_volume.description: Number of source files to pack into a single parity volume. Corresponds to the -p option.
